name: X-Men: Children of the Atom
history: Capcom’s first Marvel-character fighting game. Mutants and enemies battle in large, animated arenas, with X-Power abilities and air combos. The arcade story climaxes in confrontations with Juggernaut and Magneto.
mechanics: Mutant battles, large sprites, X-Power, air combos; original arcade bosses Juggernaut and Magneto.

name: Marvel Super Heroes
history: A one-on-one Marvel fighter built around the six Infinity Gems. Gem choice and activation changes battle tactics while the story builds toward Thanos.
